info.title: Social Media API
info.description:
Social Media App is a scalable backend API for a video-focused social platform, built with Node.js and Express.

It provides complete social features including authentication (JWT + Google OAuth), user profiles, videos, comments, likes, subscriptions, playlists, watch later/history, notifications, reporting, and admin moderation.

The architecture is production-oriented: MongoDB for core data, Redis + BullMQ for background jobs (analytics, media, email, notifications), Cloudinary for media handling, and rate-limiting/security middleware for protection.

It also includes personalized recommendations and channel analytics, plus Swagger docs, Docker support, and Jest tests for reliability.
